scientific_integrity: Proof includes an analytic all-q sign argument, critical equality space and asymptotic; finite exact rational and spectral calculations are corroborative only. The claim is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Finite unit-edge once-subdivided q-arm stars with all vertices, q>=3; q=2 treated separately. Does not cover weighted/deeper/unequal-arm trees; literature completeness and priority are not independently established.
title: Exact negative type and an inverse-branching law for once-subdivided metric stars
